in_marathi.name: Manvith
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mind or intellect
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manvith हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manvith is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'manas' meaning mind or intellect. It is also believed to be the name of the first creator of the universe in Hindu mythology.
